description: Use this when someone asks what to do this week or next, or what GatherHQ suggests they do: returns up to six next steps for the workspace, across publishing, competitors, testing and research, each with why now and the tool that does it: an article or answer to publish (from questions its buyers raise in interviews, what people search, and where AI answers cite others instead), a competitor's move to answer, a simulation to run before deciding, a study to run with real people, and this week's step toward a goal. From what GatherHQ keeps for the workspace; when no research ideas or competitor moves are saved, GatherHQ looks them up on the web and saves them to the workspace, and a part still being made says so. It runs no research: offer the steps and wait for the person to pick one. For research ideas alone use gather_research_ideas; for what to publish alone, gather_what_to_publish; for competitors alone, gather_competitors.
name: gather_this_week
title: What to do this week
